name: Slide Projector
description: A slide projector changes slides: the first picture is jerked up out of the frame, blurring as it leaves the focal plane, the bare lamp flickers on the screen for an instant, then the second picture drops in from the top, bounces and hunts for focus before it sharpens. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: bounce
params.description: How high the second slide bounces when it lands in the gate

params.name: defocus
params.description: How out of focus the slides get while they move

params.name: flicker
params.description: How much the lamp flickers during the change

params.name: lamp_color
params.description: Color of the lamp light on the screen while the gate is empty
